title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-jordan-lee
content:
Quick notes for 1:1 with Jordan Lee (CSM) — 2026-03-18

Context / goals:
- Prep for weekly 1:1: focus on top customer at-risk (Acme Retail), upsell motion for Dedicated, and SE enablement request.
- Outcome I want: list of concrete next steps with owners + dates (renewal risk mitigation plan + pilot kickoff timeline).

Agenda (30m)
1) Quick personal check-in (2-3m)
2) Acme Retail health + renewal (10m)
   - Usage dropped ~35% last 6 weeks; billing flagged but no official NPS yet.
   - Last exec sync: engineering promised latency improvement in EMEA cluster (incidents 2026-02-20, 2026-03-05).
   - Renewal date: 2026-07-01 (Q3).
3) Upsell opportunity: Dedicated pool for "search-relevance" workload (8m)
   - Jordan: customer is interested if we can guarantee 95th p99 < 200ms and 99.9% monthly uptime.
   - Need cost estimate + pilot plan.
4) SE/solutions ask (5m)
   - Jordan wants an SE to join next customer call and own technical scoping.
5) Review action items + next steps (2-3m)

Notes / talking points:
- Health metrics (bring numbers): token volume (30d), p50/p95/p99 latency by region, error rate, recent deploys. I should pull last 30d usage and latency charts from Console before the sync.
- Hypothesis for drop: customer moved batch preprocessing off our streaming API to local transform to save costs; may have inadvertently reduced calls. Also possible model variant switch they tried (v1.3 -> v1.4-q4) caused perf regressions.
- Escalation: SRE runbook executed for the two incidents; SRE notes indicate kernel mismatch on EMEA cluster (ticket JIRA-2048). Ask Jordan if customer received incident RCA; offer follow-up office hours with SRE.
- Upsell framing: pitch Dedicated as reliability + predictable cost. Prepare a 4-week pilot: 2 GPUs reserved, smoke test with their peak queries, SLA target defined, demo of Console dashboards + rollback plan. Need rough pricing tiers to discuss.
- SE ask: recommend Diego or Priya to join. Diego has domain knowledge on search-relevance models. Suggest synchronizing SE calendar for a technical deep-dive next Tues (2026-03-24).

Action items (who / what / due)
- Jordan: confirm whether Acme received RCA and internal exec sentiment; update by 2026-03-20.
- Avery (me): pull Console metrics (30d token usage, latency by region, error rate) and attach charts to this doc; due 2026-03-19.
- Diego: draft pilot plan + resource estimate for Dedicated (2 GPU config + cost delta) and example SLOs; due 2026-03-22.
- SRE (cc via JIRA-2048): produce short summary note for customer (RCA highlight) and availability for office hours; request by 2026-03-21.
- Jordan & SE: schedule technical deep-dive with customer (target 2026-03-24); Jordan to confirm attendees by 2026-03-20.

Risks / open questions:
- If Acme demands contractual SLA higher than our standard Dedicated tiers we may need sales/legal involvement. Flag to me in advance.
- Does the pilot need data residency constraints? Confirm with Jordan whether data must stay in EU.

Prep checklist for the call (items I will bring)
- Console screenshots: 30d usage + latency by region (Avery)
- Draft pilot outline / pricing (Diego)
- RCA summary from SRE (link to JIRA-2048)
- One-pager: Dedicated value props + rollback/fallback plan

Follow-up template (post 1:1)
- Short recap email to Jordan with action items + owners + due dates (I will send within 24h).
- Create JIRA EPIC for Acme renewal mitigation + pilot tickets and link to this doc (I will create JIRA after our sync).

Next meeting
- Weekly 1:1 as usual; propose to add a short triage sync with SE and Jordan on 2026-03-24 if pilot moves forward.

Notes to self (scratchpad)
- Pull model variant change log for Acme accounts (Model Catalog history).
- Check billing alert thresholds; maybe propose temporary credits to reduce churn risk.
- If Jordan is blocked on legal terms, introduce Aaron (sales legal) early.

End of prep notes.
